# windows_registry_key (Data Source)

Reads the value-name enumeration of a Windows registry key without managing its lifecycle.

Lookup keys: `hive` and `path` (both required).

`value_names` lists every value name (`""` is the Default value); `values` adds the registry type per name for drift detection without purge. For value payloads use the `windows_registry_value` data source.

Returns an error when the registry key does not exist on the target host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Enumerate a key for drift detection without purge.
data "windows_registry_key" "app" {
  hive = "HKLM"
  path = "SOFTWARE\\MyApp"
}

output "registry_value_names" {
  value = data.windows_registry_key.app.value_names
}

output "registry_values_summary" {
  value = data.windows_registry_key.app.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hive` (String) Registry hive: HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, or HKCC (case-insensitive, normalised to uppercase).
- `path` (String) Subkey path under the hive (backslash-separated, no leading/trailing backslash).

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: "<HIVE>\<PATH>".
- `value_names` (List of String) Live value names enumerated in the key. The Default (unnamed) value appears as "".
- `values` (Attributes List) Name+kind summary of every value in the key, for drift detection without purge. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Value name ("" is the Default value).
- `type` (String) Registry value type: REG_SZ, REG_EXPAND_SZ, REG_MULTI_SZ, REG_DWORD, REG_QWORD, REG_BINARY, or REG_NONE.
